material.acceptance_criteria: A served room reports the winner (or none) on /state or as one ev= line when it is declared; the moba job reads it.
material.description: The sim declares a winner through declare_winner (rust/crates/sim/src/triggers.rs, Sim::winner()), and the gate prints win trigger ok from its own scenario. The served /state and the server log do not report the winner for a running room, so the moba job cannot print moba match ok winner=<side> ticks=<n> without reading it. scenarios/moba now tags bases with building and declares the winner on base loss (win_on_base_loss); the match check is left out until the winner is readable.
material.subject: Expose the declared winner to the CI witness for the moba match
material.witness: commit 0ca2fb6301b7865edbd3f5e08f5096dddf1194fb; CI run 39081397284 success; live witness winner=0 tick=1416
material.witness_plan: The moba job prints moba match ok winner=<side> ticks=<n> with ticks bounded by a count derived from the .osd files.
